## What landed

The mathematical heart of the eight-lift partition (128) — the fact that the continuous-hom lifts of a fixed map through a central double cover `p` form a **torsor under `Hom_cont(Γ, 𝔽₂)`** — is now a set of verified, reusable lemmas in [GQ2/SectionEight.lean](GQ2/SectionEight.lean):

- **`z`-arithmetic**: `orderOf_z` (= 2), `z_pow_eq_iff` (`z^a = z^b ↔ a ≡ b [MOD 2]`), `p_z`/`p_z_pow`, `z_pow_central`, `eq_one_or_z_of_mem_ker` (`⟨z⟩ = {1,z}`).
- **Freeness**: `p_comp_scalarTwist` (the twist stays in the fibre) + `scalarTwist_left_injective`.
- **Transitivity**: `liftChar`/`liftChar_rep`/`liftChar_add` → `liftDiff` + `scalarTwist_liftDiff` — *any two lifts differ by a unique 𝔽₂-character*. Built representation-first (`g' γ = g γ · z^{χ γ}`, χ additive by cancelling `g(γδ) = gγ·gδ` and reading off `z^a = z^b ⇒ a ≡ b`), which sidesteps a 4-way `if`-case split.
- **Packaged**: **`fiberLiftEquiv : Hom_cont(Γ,𝔽₂) ≃ {g // p∘g = p∘g₀}`** — each fibre has exactly `|Hom|` lifts, i.e. the "8 lifts". This is directly reused by 8.6 (the half-torsor) and 8.9's (139) half-count.

All verified at exactly std-3; build green; guard green (census 12); no lines over 100.

I judged this ~200 lines of Mathlib `card`/`Sigma`/subgroup plumbing to be lower-value than landing the clean torsor core, especially since 8.6/8.9 remain blocked on P-13/P-15 regardless — so `lemma_8_3` doesn't unblock the chain on its own.
